mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_device(member_id, platform, token, environment, bundle_id, locale, enabled, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{platform}, #{token}, #{environment}, #{bundleId}, #{locale}, 1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id = VALUES(member_id), platform = VALUES(platform), bundle_id = VALUES(bundle_id), locale = VALUES(locale), enabled = 1, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM push_device WHERE token = #{token} AND environment = #{environment}
mapper.update: UPDATE push_device SET enabled = 0 WHERE token = #{token} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND enabled = 1
UPDATE push_device SET enabled = 0 WHERE token = #{token} AND environment = #{environment} AND enabled = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, token, environment, locale FROM push_device WHERE enabled = 1 AND environment = #{environment} AND member_id IN #{m} ORDER BY member_id, last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 5000

SELECT msg.id AS messageId, msg.conversation_id AS conversationId, msg.sender_id AS senderId, msg.msg_type AS msgType, msg.content AS content, msg.extra_json AS extraJson, msg.status AS status, msg.check_status AS checkStatus, c.type + 0 AS conversationType, c.biz_key AS bizKey, c.status AS conversationStatus, c.last_msg_text AS summary, u.nickname AS senderName FROM im_message msg JOIN im_conversation c ON c.id = msg.conversation_id LEFT JOIN ums_member u ON u.id = msg.sender_id WHERE msg.id = #{messageId}

SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.muted AS memberMuted, p.level AS convLevel, p.permanent_muted AS convPermanent, (p.muted_until IS NOT NULL AND p.muted_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS convMutedActive, p.quiet_start AS convQuietStart, p.quiet_end AS convQuietEnd, p.quiet_tz AS convQuietTz, p.suppress_broadcast AS suppressBroadcast, p.show_preview AS convShowPreview, a.level AS accountLevel, a.quiet_start AS accountQuietStart, a.quiet_end AS accountQuietEnd, a.quiet_tz AS accountQuietTz, a.show_preview AS accountShowPreview FROM im_conversation_member m LEFT JOIN im_notify_pref p ON p.member_id = m.member_id AND p.scope_type = 1 AND p.scope_id = m.conversation_id LEFT JOIN im_notify_pref a ON a.member_id = m.member_id AND a.scope_type = 4 AND a.scope_id = m.member_id WHERE m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.member_id <> #{senderId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM im_block b WHERE b.member_id = m.member_id AND b.blocked_member_id = #{senderId}) AND m.member_id > #{afterMemberId} ORDER BY m.member_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ch.name AS channelName, ch.kind AS channelKind, ch.guild_kind AS guildKind, ch.guild_id AS guildId, ch.notify_default AS notifyDefault, CASE WHEN ch.guild_kind = 1 THEN c.name ELSE t.title END AS guildName FROM im_channel ch LEFT JOIN club c ON ch.guild_kind = 1 AND c.id = ch.guild_id LEFT JOIN play_team t ON ch.guild_kind = 3 AND t.id = ch.guild_id WHERE ch.id = #{conversationId} AND ch.del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM channel_event WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT mention_type AS mentionType, target_id AS targetId FROM im_message_mention WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
SELECT guild_id FROM im_channel WHERE id = #{conversationId} AND guild_kind = 1 AND del_flag = 0
SELECT level FROM im_club_notify_default WHERE club_id = #{clubId}

SELECT level, permanent_muted AS permanentMuted, (muted_until IS NOT NULL AND muted_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) AS mutedActive, quiet_start AS quietStart, quiet_end AS quietEnd, quiet_tz AS quietTz, show_preview AS showPreview FROM im_notify_pref WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_id = #{scopeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO club_event_campaign_push(campaign_id, channel) VALUES (#{campaignId}, 'APNS')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM club_event_campaign_push WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
